title: Workspace Persistence & Sidebar Improvements
description: Introduces connection-aware workspace persistence, a new sidebar toggle for switching between tables and saved tabs, and safety features for unsaved work.

items.title: Workspace Persistence
items.description: Tabs (chats, spreadsheets, queries) are now saved per connection. Work is automatically saved and restored when you switch connections.

items.title: Sidebar Toggle
items.description: Switch between 'Tables' and 'Tabs' view in the sidebar to manage your saved sessions for the active connection.

items.title: Temporary Workspace Safety
items.description: Unsaved tabs in the temporary workspace trigger a visual warning. Switching to a connection prompts to move or discard these tabs.

items.title: Workspace Service
items.description: New backend service to manage workspace state, persisting active tabs to the database per connection.

items.title: Connection-Aware Store
items.description: Refactored workspace store to handle multiple workspace contexts (temp vs connections).
